title: ED blood test result documentation

user_facing_items.final_wording: Supports a traceable record of review, action, responsibility, referral and handover for pathology and radiology results.
user_facing_items.population: Adults and children whose pathology or radiology investigations were requested or reviewed by an emergency department.
user_facing_items.setting: Emergency department result review, communication, handover and follow-up governance.
user_facing_items.jurisdiction: United Kingdom emergency medicine; requires UAE governance and pathway adaptation
restrictions: Exact for recording which test was requested, the result or report review, action taken, responsibility, referral or handover and patient communication. It does not interpret a result or generate management.
user_facing_items.rationale: The exact RCEM results section supports documenting why a result is being reviewed, its source or date when available, the specific test and a traceable clinician review; it does not interpret the result.

user_facing_items.final_wording: Supports documenting the specific test, reviewed result or report, communication and clinician-determined follow-up action.
